openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: Small router with 5 gigabit ports, dual-band 802.11ac Wi-Fi, and a powerful quad-core ARM CPU. The commercial name of the router is hAP ac² or sometimes hAP ac 2.
openwrt_wiki.Hinweis RAM: Early revisions seemed to ship with 256 MiB of RAM (see wikidevi). However, revisions available in 2019 only ship with 128 MiB of RAM.
openwrt_wiki.Installation: Installation is done like other MikroTik devices: boot an initramfs image over TFTP, and if all works well, flash the final image using sysupgrade. Do NOT upgrade to RouterOS v7, its bootloader is not compatible with OpenWrt; if you upgraded, downgrade to RouterOS v6 before installing OpenWrt. Warning: To boot OpenWrt on hAP ac², RouteurBoot needs BOOTP and doesn't support DHCP.
openwrt_wiki.Debricking: Reset Button, the Mikrotik Netinstall tool and the right firmware file do the job. The hap ac2 is based on Router OS 6, ARM Plattform (32Bit)
openwrt_wiki.Network interfaces: 5 ethernet interfaces connected to the CPU via a switch integrated in the SoC ipq4018, plus two radio circuits (2.4 GHz, 5 GHz). On the encasing they are designated #1 (Internet/PoE in), and #2 - #5 (LAN). swconfig: VLAN 1 ports 0t 1 2 3 4, VLAN 2 ports 0t 5; port 0 CPU, 5 Internet/PoE, LAN #2-#5 = ports 4-1 (reverse order).
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: Opening the case is not easy at first, but there are videos on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3vu2AOydsls
openwrt_wiki.Serial: Instructions for soldering pins for the serial port: Connect to RX, TX and GND. Pad-Skizze (10 Pads): obere Reihe DI, RX, CS, DO, quadratisches Pad; untere Reihe GND, -, TX (WP), VCC, GND. Zweite Skizze SPI-Flash: DI, CLK, -, VCC links; GND, -, DO, CS rechts.
openwrt_wiki.Enable serial output: By default, no serial is shown during boot. To enable it, a value needs to be changed on the flash (you can do that from an OpenWrt initramfs image): CHANGE position e030, before bytes 40 20 08, there's a 05, you need to change it to 00
openwrt_wiki.OpenWrt bootlog: Linux 5.4.110, Machine model: MikroTik hAP ac2, Memory 117796K/131072K, spi-nor w25q128jv (16384 Kbytes), Partitionen Qualcomm 0x0-0x80000, RouterBoot 0x80000-0x100000 (hard_config, dtb_config, soft_config), firmware 0x100000-0x1000000; ath10k_ahb qca4019 hw1.0 (2 Radios), xhci 1 USB-2- und 1 USB-3-Root-Hub, console ttyMSM0 115200

openwrt_wiki_seriell_foto.Inhalt: Platinenausschnitt mit SPI-Flash U901 (Winbond 25Q128JV...), daneben Feld aus 2x5 SMD-Loetpunkten mit Aufdruck "SPI + UART", ein Pad quadratisch; drei Draehte (schwarz, gruen, rot) direkt auf die Pads geloetet, keine Stiftleiste. Links Aufdruck RESET und 10-28V an der DC-Buchse.

wikidevi.Platinenaufdruck: "MikroTik", "D52G-5HacD2HnD" and "hAP ac2 series" is silkscreened on the board.
wikidevi.Kurzbeschreibung: hAP ac2 (tower case) - FCC ID TV7RBD52-5ACD2ND (2018-01-15); 5x GbE ports, PoE, USB 2.0, Wave 2 (2x2 2.4/5GHz); CPU Qualcomm IPQ4018 @716MHz, 16/128MB

mikrotik_produktseite.Kurzbeschreibung: Dual-Concurrent 2.4/5GHz AP, 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, Five Gigabit Ethernet ports, USB for 3G/4G support, universal tower case and IPsec hardware encryption support
mikrotik_produktseite.Text: New design universal case allows unit to be positioned either horizontally (desktop) or vertically (tower case). Wall anchored mounting kit is provided.
mikrotik_produktseite.Versionen: hAP ac²-US (USA) is factory locked for 2412-2462MHz, 5170-5250MHz and 5725-5835MHz frequencies. This lock can not be removed. hAP ac² (International) supports 2412-2484MHz and 5150MHz-5875MHz range.
mikrotik_produktseite.Ethernet test results: RBD52G-5HacD2HnD-TCr2, IPQ-4018 1G all port test: Routing fast path 1518 byte 1973.4 Mbps, 64 byte 761.9 Mbps; 25 ip filter rules 64 byte 124.4 Mbps
mikrotik_produktseite.IPsec test results: RBD52G-5HacD2HnD-TCr2: Single tunnel AES-128-CBC + SHA1 1400 byte 424.5 Mbps

mikrotik_brochure.Text: The hAP ac² can be powered from the power jack or with passive PoE from a PoE injector. The power adapter is included. New design universal case allows unit to be positioned either horizontally (desktop) or vertically (tower case). Wall anchored mounting kit is provided.
mikrotik_brochure.Extras: USB 2.0 Type A full size port, 1 A

mikrotik_quickguide.Powering: The device accepts powering from the power jack or from the first Ethernet port (Passive PoE): direct-input power jack (5.5mm outside and 2mm inside, female, pin positive plug) accepts 12-30 V DC; first Ethernet port accepts passive Power over Ethernet accepts 18-28 V DC (comensate for loss on cable, so more than 12V recommended). The power consumption under maximum load can reach 15 W.
mikrotik_quickguide.Setup: Connect your internet cable to the first port; default 192.168.88.1
mikrotik_quickguide.Extension slots and ports: The Ethernet ports are connected through a switch chip, can be configured individually and support automatic cross/straight cable correction (Auto MDI/X).
mikrotik_quickguide.Buttons and jumpers: RouterBOOT reset button: hold before power on -> backup boot loader; release when green LED starts flashing -> reset RouterOS configuration; release after LED is no longer flashing (~20 seconds) -> Netinstall.
mikrotik_quickguide.EU Frequency bands: 2412-2472 MHz 20 dBm; 5150-5250 MHz 23 dBm indoor; 5250-5350 MHz 20 dBm indoor; 5470-5725 MHz 27 dBm
mikrotik_quickguide.Hersteller: Mikrotikls SIA, Brivibas gatve 214i Riga, Latvia, LV1039
